note: Approval hashes (ADR-490, DOD-07), shared by server/messaging/src/approval.ts and DoddyCore ApprovalHash. Generated independently of both; each must reproduce every vector.
encoding: SHA-256 over each field in order, written as its UTF-8 byte length in decimal, a colon, then its UTF-8 bytes. Lowercase hex. A text approval is the fields ["doddy-approval-1", "text", recipient in E.164, the exact text]. A call approval (ADR-495) is ["doddy-approval-1", "call", recipient in E.164, the time in UTC as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, the exact reason, "1" if allowed in quiet hours else "0"].
